## Objective
- Build a complete, playable German-language FIA race-control simulator in the existing game project.

## Requirements
- Simulate a full race weekend, current circuits and teams, incidents, steward decisions, telemetry, replays, race-control actions, weather, statistics, and media reactions.

- Finish the German-language FIA race-control simulator, fix its JavaScript, and verify core gameplay in a browser.

- Simulate a race weekend with incidents, steward decisions, telemetry/replays, race-control actions, weather, statistics, and media reactions.
